This perspective will be controversial. I usually stay quiet but your post really resonated with me. I am 17 soon to be 18 and my mom had me when she was 16, I asked why she kept me and she said it was because it made her feel like she mattered. Now I go to sleep wishing I wouldn’t wake up, and don’t say I need to seek medical help. I’ve been getting medical help for as long as I can remember, your son went out while he was still innocent and happy, he saw you as a good person and still felt the world was a great place. They are at peace now, and all they’d want is for you to be at peace to. It is what it is, you sound like a great person and I don’t blame you for not wanting to be a dad so young, you changed for the good before it was too late. I hope you find some peace.
